entries.title: Notes editor and notes store drift apart and the editor overwrites the store: an agent write_note into the open note is invisible and clobbered by the next keystroke, clearing a note never persists, and edits within 600 ms of a scope switch or tab close are lost
entries.repro: (1) Notes open on General; agent write_note appends to General (host-actions.ts:1176-1191) -> editor still shows the old body (scope effect early-returns when prevScopeRef===scope) -> type one char -> 600 ms later the stale body + char replaces the agent's text in store and .md, while chat said 'Appended'. (2) Select-all + Delete -> editorMarkdown '' and debouncedMd '' -> guard at NotesPanel.tsx:169 returns -> old note resurrects on scope switch/relaunch. (3) Type in AAPL, switch to MSFT within 600 ms -> Tiptap setContent emits an update (emitUpdate defaults true) -> AAPL's last burst never written. (4) Close the Notes tab within 600 ms of typing -> debounce cleared, no flush.
entries.evidence: src/modules/notes/NotesPanel.tsx:45-52, :139-148, :150-178, :169; src/lib/host-actions.ts:1176-1191; src/store/notes.ts:58-65, :91-96; node_modules/@tiptap/core/src/commands/setContent.ts:51. Refuter: -1 admitted_with_correction high (workspace-load half refuted: fromJSON remounts the panel), -2 admitted high.
entries.root_cause: Two owners of the note body (Tiptap doc and useNotesStore) reconciled only on a scope-change edge; the debounced save is keyed to the scope current when the timer fires, an empty-guard meant for mount also swallows a real empty save, programmatic setContent emits user-update events, and unmount does not flush.
entries.fix_shape: Make the store authoritative: subscribe the editor to noteFor(scope) and setContent(value, {emitUpdate:false}) when it differs from lastWrittenRef; capture {scope, md} at update time and flush synchronously on scope change/unmount; replace the empty-guard with a 'user has edited' flag. Pin with vitest+jsdom: store write while editor open is shown and survives a keystroke; clear-all persists ''; type-then-switch within 600 ms persists the first scope's text.

entries.repro: (1) python -c 'from services.agent_tools.catalog import agent_selectable_tool_ids as f; print(len(f()))' -> 50; the builder's Tools row renders exactly the 20 in form.tsx:21-42. (2) POST /custom-agents tools:[research, web_search, price_data] (accepted) -> Edit in builder -> change Name -> Save -> PUT sends tools:[price_data]. entries.title: Portfolio live-quote failure is indistinguishable from 'symbol not found': fetchPositionQuote swallows every error to null, so the failure banner and its Retry (the panel's only recovery) can never render
entries.repro: Stop the sidecar or break /quotes with holdings present -> every Price/Mkt val/P&L cell shows '—' and the footer says 'N without a live quote'; the warning banner never appears and Retry is unreachable, so the panel stays dashed until the holding set changes or it remounts.

entries.title: Screener results are a silent top-200-by-market-cap page: the header's 'N rows' is the page cap not the match count, and column sort only reorders that page — 'lowest P/E on the NSE' can never surface a small cap
entries.repro: india-all, 0<P/E<40, limit 200 (what Run always sends) -> result_count 200; same screen at limit 1000 -> 1000 (both evaluated 5,066); header '200 rows (5066 evaluated…)'. Click 'P/E' ascending -> lowest P/E among the 200 largest caps, not the universe. No control raises the limit or pages.

Pin with a sidecar test (sort applied pre-limit; matched_count > result_count) and a panel test on the header copy.

entries.title: Clicking a screener preset while a Nested group or formula is set silently runs the OLD tree and formula and presents the rows as the named preset
entries.repro: Real store + panel against the live sidecar: Nested mode with group (P/E<12 OR yield>4%) and formula 'pe < 12' -> click 'Founder-aligned (NSE)' -> request = preset criteria + old group + formula -> 3 rows (NTPC, ONGC, COALINDIA); same preset from a clean store -> 18 rows. Builder still shows the old nested tree.

entries.root_cause: The preset writes only the flat criteria list; runScreener gives the nested tree precedence and ANDs the formula; setCriteria does not clear group/advanced/formula while resetCriteria/applyFilters do.
entries.fix_shape: Presets go through the same reset as resetCriteria (group:null, advanced:false, formula:'') before setCriteria, or build the request from the preset directly. Pin with a store test: preset apply after nested+formula sends exactly the preset's criteria.

entries.title: Provider/key validation is split across three boolean-returning clients that erase why validation failed: a stopped sidecar or unreachable provider reads as 'That key wasn't accepted by OpenRouter' in onboarding or 'No AI model is set up yet' (auto-opening onboarding) in chat, with no timeout and Cancel disabled while validating

(2) Onboarding offline or OpenRouter down, paste a VALID key -> validateKey catch -> false -> 'That key wasn't accepted by OpenRouter'. (3) Key dialog against a hanging endpoint -> 'Validating…' with Save and Cancel both disabled (Escape still closes).

Pin with helper unit tests per reason and a ChatSidebar test that an unreachable sidecar does not open onboarding.

entries.title: A dead or unreachable sidecar surfaces as WebKit's bare 'Load failed' in every panel and in chat, and a sidecar crash is never signalled or respawned
entries.repro: Kill the sidecar -> sidecarGet's fetch() (outside any try) rejects with TypeError 'Load failed' (WKWebView) which stores copy into panel error state (e.g. store/macro.ts:93-99); chat shows 'Something went wrong — Load failed'. The Rust event loop drops CommandEvent::Terminated, readyPromise stays resolved, so every later call takes this path.

Restart Vysted.') and an SSE error frame code='sidecar_unreachable'; emit a sidecar-terminated event from lib.rs so the status chrome can say so (respawn is a separate decision). Pin with sidecar-client and streaming tests mocking a rejected fetch.
